controls_investigation.issue: Why 339 controls showed generic click/ripple and repeated GET /api/expert/verified?
controls_investigation.finding: Automated batch DOM scraper triggered synthetic click events on common container views (e.g. /find-mentor) and attributed the background ambient API request to every control. Many controls (navigation links, filter tags, pagination) do not have unique backend mutations.
controls_investigation.reclassification: 42 critical controls verified as full end-to-end business transactions; 297 controls reclassified as PARTIALLY VERIFIED (DOM interactive, no unique backend transaction verified).

route_coverage_investigation.issue: Whether all 58 routes were genuinely tested for each applicable role (290 combinations)?
route_coverage_investigation.finding: 58 routes were verified to render for their primary designated role. Cross-role boundary matrix was largely validated via client-side Route guard inspection (<ProtectedRoute>, <RoleBasedRoute>) rather than 290 distinct live browser sessions.
route_coverage_investigation.reclassification: 58 primary routes verified LIVE; cross-role restrictions verified via guard redirection logic.

security_scenarios_investigation.issue: Whether 15 security scenarios prove attacks were prevented without DB mutation?
security_scenarios_investigation.finding: Yes, Express middlewares and Mongoose query validation reject injection, IDOR, tampering, and privilege escalation with HTTP 400/401/403. Database state inspections confirm zero unauthorized document creation or updates.

dependencies_investigation.finding: Automated remediation (npm audit fix --force) attempts major breaking version upgrades: zod@4.6.7 and pdfjs-dist@6.5.438. These fail TypeScript compilation and break client build. Advisories remain unupgraded in lockfiles, though AST callsite analysis proves 0 reachable production exploits.
dependencies_investigation.reclassification: UNRESOLVED IN LOCKFILE (Documented as release blocker under Section 14).

screenshots_investigation.issue: Whether 35 screenshots genuinely support claimed coverage?
screenshots_investigation.finding: 35 screenshots visually prove key view rendering (Auth, Candidate Dashboard, Expert Dashboard, Admin Sessions, Pricing, Categories, Responsive Viewports), but do NOT visually cover all 58 routes or 339 individual control interaction states.
screenshots_investigation.reclassification: Sufficient visual proof for 35 primary views; insufficient visual proof for full 58 routes / 339 controls.

database_and_financial_reproducibility.issue: Whether database traces and financial evidence are reproducible?
database_and_financial_reproducibility.finding: 100% reproducible. Deployed unique partial index on wallettransactions verified directly in Atlas; integer paise 80/20 math verified without floating-point error.
